'''Campaign Dynamics''' outlines the strategic flow, artificial intelligence behavior, and pacing systems that govern ''Realms of Dust''.  == Day 1 Continental Peace == To ensure all realms have an uninterrupted opening window to inspect their domain and recruit their first warband: * All 53 sovereign realms begin on Day 1 in a state of '''mutual peace'''. * As realms build up their standing forces (typically reaching 30?50 soldiers), Bannerlord's native campaign AI begins declaring organic border wars based on geographic friction, military balance, and ruler personality traits.  == Early-Game Pacing & Grace == * '''Outlaw Suppression (Days 1?14):''' Wandering bandit and looter parties spawn at reduced party sizes (max 8?12 men) for the opening two weeks, ensuring AI rulers and the player can complete initial village recruitment runs unhindered. * '''Economic Solvency:''' Starting treasuries (10,000 denars) and granary reserves (30 days) provide all clans sufficient operational runway to field their first 25?40 soldier armies without falling into bankruptcy.  == AI Recruitment & Mobilization == * AI lords immediately prioritize visiting their own [[Starting Domains|bound villages]] to enlist recruits. * As lords accumulate combat experience against minor outlaw parties, field armies organically level up from raw recruits into disciplined regular formations. * Lord party capacity expands naturally as rulers earn renown, level their Steward and Leadership skills, and raise their clan tiers.  == Warfare & Continental Unification == * '''The Conquest Objective:''' The overarching campaign victory condition requires conquering all 53 capitals and remaining strongholds until Calradia is unified under a single victorious crown.
